h2: font-size: 17pt; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); margin: 24px 0px 5px; line-height: 1.38; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;
h3: font-size: 13pt; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); margin: 18px 0px 4px; line-height: 1.38; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;
p: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.65; margin: 10px 0px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);
li: margin: 6px 0px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-size: 12pt; font-weight: 500; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.65;
em: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.65;
table: border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 16px 0px; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); border: 2px solid rgb(85, 85, 85); table-layout: auto;
th: border-width: 1px 1px 2px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(0, 0, 0) rgb(153, 153, 153) rgb(85, 85, 85); border-image: initial; padding: 9px 12px; vertical-align: top; color: rgb(17, 17, 17); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.55; font-weight: 700; background: rgb(238, 240, 242); text-align: left;
td: border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); padding: 9px 12px; vertical-align: top; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.55;
ul: margin: 10px 0px; padding-left: 28px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.65;
